title: Prävention im Fokus: Polizei Berlin lädt zur Sonderberatung am Tag des Einbruchschutzes am 25. Oktober 2026 ein

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin police and a carpentry guild invite the public to a free burglary-prevention advice day on 25 October 2026 at police headquarters. Security technology is shown, including a live forced-entry demonstration at 13:00.
